fato_historico: 1999: EgyptAir Flight 990 crashes into the Atlantic Ocean near Nantucket, killing all 217 people on board.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle tide shifting under the moon. Just as the vast ocean holds both mysteries and deep peace, your spirit is invited to reflect on the fragility of life. It is a good time to cherish those you love and cultivate serenity, finding beauty in the balance that exists between the light and the shadows.
frase_do_dia: Peace flows like water when you choose to embrace the present moment.
significado_numero: A number representing spiritual awakening and the pursuit of inner truth.
conselho: Consider reaching out to a dear friend and expressing your true gratitude today.
